subject: Aligning demo timing and onboarding: security + procurement
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 03 Oct 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Aligning demo timing and onboarding: security + procurement

Hi Sarah —

Thanks again for the conversation today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned: 

- Recap: you’re evaluating Redwood for a real-time inference layer (text generation + embeddings) across a US-only environment. Key constraints: SSO via Okta, SOC 2 evidence, and procurement lead times for PO/terms.
- Next meeting: 60-minute technical deep dive + demo (we’ll include SSO/infra and security Q&A).
- People we should loop: your CISO and procurement contact (for evidence and contracting questions); our security lead (Marissa) and solutions lead (I'll run the demo).

Can you confirm which of these options work on your side? I’ve intentionally left 3 windows across timezones:
1) Thu 10/05 10:00–11:00 PT
2) Thu 10/05 14:00–15:00 PT
3) Fri 10/06 09:00–10:00 PT

If none of the times work, feel free to suggest two alternatives and I’ll coordinate. Also attaching a short procurement checklist and the high-level architecture doc to speed review (attachment: procurement_requirements.xlsx).

Thanks — looking forward to getting the right folks on a call.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
https://redwood.ai

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@finlytics.com>

Subject: Re: Aligning demo timing and onboarding: security + procurement

Hi Rachel —

Thanks for the clear recap. Option 2 (Thu 10/05 14:00–15:00 PT) looks best for us. I’ve looped in our CISO (Jane Park) and procurement (Tom Ellis) so they can join the demo or drop in for the security/terms sections.

A couple of asks up front so Marissa and your team can prepare:
- Can you confirm whether Redwood supports strict US-only data residency and if there are SOC 2 artifacts we can pre-review?
- Any details on expected token throughput and a rough cost estimate for pilot (we can cover numbers in the call but a ballpark in advance helps procurement).

I’ve attached our internal procurement intake form — it mostly lists contract/legal points and timelines.

Looking forward to the demo on Thursday.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Platform Engineering, Finlytics

Thanks Sarah — great, locking in Thu 10/05 14:00–15:00 PT for the technical deep dive.

Marissa (cc) will cover SOC 2/controls and provide the specific artifact list ahead of the call. Sean (cc) from our solutions team will cover throughput characteristics and cost modeling for your pilot profile.

Quick answers to Sarah’s asks so folks have context before Thursday:
- US-only residency: yes — we support region-restricted deployments. We’ll surface options (hosted with region pinning or Dedicated in your VPC) during the demo.
- SOC 2 artifacts: Marissa will share the standard SOC 2 summary and the list of available supporting documents; anything requiring an NDA/PO we’ll gate behind a secure link.
- Throughput/cost: Sean will prepare a short slide with ballpark numbers (tokens/sec and estimated monthly for a 3-month pilot) and a couple of configuration options (batched small instances vs reserved Dedicated).

Sarah / Jane / Tom — if you want us to cover procurement timing and standard terms up front, we can leave 10–15 minutes at the end for contracting questions.

Thanks — see you Thursday.

Best,
Rachel

Hi all —

I’m available for the 10/05 14:00 PT slot and will prepare the throughput/cost slide and a short security evidence checklist (what we can share pre-call vs gated). Attaching a SOC 2 snapshot and a template network diagram so Jane has something to review ahead of time.

Proposed run of show for the 60m session:
- 0–10m: quick intros and success criteria (Rachel)
- 10–30m: demo of platform and SSO/workflow (Rachel + Sean)
- 30–45m: security artifacts / evidence & Ops questions (Marissa)
- 45–60m: procurement / contracting cadence + next steps (Rachel + Sean)

If procurement wants us to share standard terms or sample SOW language pre-call, let me know and I’ll surface the templates.

Regards,
Sean Gallagher
